Maria (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — we're planning a base-image rebuild to strip setuid binaries, add a tighter seccomp policy, and rotate provenance metadata. Need RBAC tweaks + KMS signing access and audit log updates before we can cosign and cutover. Target window: Tue 03:00 UTC.
Raj (platform-sre): Do we have the exact KMS resource path? Last time GCP KMS needed a very specific grant to the builder SA.
Kevin (infra): I'm available for the window. Two quick Qs: 1) signing via GCP KMS or local HSM? 2) audit retention requirements?
Maria (sec-eng): Stick with GCP KMS (already wired in infra). Retention: 90d for staging/dev, 365d for prod. Also we need a new least-privileged role 'image-signer' bound to the CI and the signer-operator.
Nate (runtime): From runtime side: ensure the image header includes the notarization signature metadata so the runtime can verify and fallback. We also need a tested rollback behavior: if cosign verify fails, runtime should fallback to previous pinned base image.
Raj (platform-sre): Draft RBAC snippet I will PR (copy below). Will grant only encrypter/decrypter for the key: 
```
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  members:
    - serviceAccount:ci-image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    - serviceAccount:signer-operator@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Kevin (infra): LGTM. Make sure we do NOT give admin or key creator. Also add a condition limiting use to the image-signing service account and to the key ring resource.
Maria (sec-eng): Also need audit pipeline change: add an 'image.sign' event to Splunk/central-audit and include the KMS key id and signer principal. @Raj can you add a webhook to the builder job to emit that event?
Raj (platform-sre): Yep — I'll add a small step in the build pipeline and open a PR. PR will include the webhook payload example and the RBAC terraform diff.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: base-image-rebuild -> Tue 03:00 UTC, canary=10%, rollback-enabled.
Kevin (infra): One more: document cosign usage pattern and rotation notes. Example verify command we'll run in runtime: 
```
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/signer <image>
```
And include a short rotation playbook for key expiry.
Nate (runtime): I'll run the staging canary and exercise the verification failure path (simulate missing signature / bad key). If verification fails, runtime should log severity=high and automatically revert to pinned-image vX.Y for 5m then alert. I'll post test notes in #eng-runtime.
Maria (sec-eng): Thanks team. Action items: Raj -> open RBAC + webhook PR; Kevin -> update cosign + rotation docs; Nate -> canary + rollback validation; I'll run vuln scan once rebuilt and confirm audit events. Please tag me in PRs. :thumbsup:
Raj (platform-sre): I'll drop the PR link here when ready.
Kevin (infra): Will prep the least-privilege terraform patch and a short runbook for emergency key revocation.
Maria (sec-eng): If anyone spots an edge-case (e.g., containerd attestation differences), flag before cutover.
Nate (runtime): noted. ping me for runbook review.
Maria (sec-eng): Closing — keeping this thread for coordination.
